name: python-snowflake-ids
title: Snowflake IDs
blurb: Time-ordered identifiers whose layout is a promise: 41 bits of milliseconds, 10 bits of worker, 12 bits of sequence, a clock that must not go backwards, a sequence that must not wrap silently, and capacity numbers you can check instead of trusting.
default_description: Generate and decode time-ordered 64-bit identifiers with an honest clock, an explicit sequence limit, and uniqueness that survives two workers.
next_steps: uv venv --allow-existing .venv && uv pip install --python .venv/bin/python -e . pytest ruff
